run_model_dump_json: run torch.utils.model_dump with --style=json on a TorchScript model file to extract model inspection data as JSON
run_model_dump_html: run torch.utils.model_dump with --style=html on a TorchScript model file to generate a self-contained HTML report
create_get_model_info: create a dictionary of model info by calling get_model_info with a TorchScript model file path
create_get_info_and_burn_skeleton: create an HTML page with model info burned in by calling get_info_and_burn_skeleton with a model file path
test_hierarchical_pickle: test hierarchical_pickle to convert Python data structures including tuples and dicts into JSON-serializable format
